name: Yokomizo Kusuko
source: A senior at Kototoi Academy. A mysterious girl who loves mystery novels and will read anything on print. Her parents own a medicine shop which focuses on Chinese medicine, which is also why Kusuko is very knowledgeable about herbal medicine. Kusuko used to be in a relationship with [url=/c53875]Bango's[/url] older [url=/c87388]brother[/url] before his disappearance.
